```{r load packages}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
```

## Transform stimlist

```{r exposure block - compile new stimuli lists, echo=FALSE}

#try one list
stimlist_df <- read.csv("../dataTan2025/experiments/TJ2025-main-exp-counterbalanced-lists/exposure-Shift0_imageSelection-backward_blockOrder-A_materials-A_block-2.csv")
summary(stimlist_df)

unlabeled_left_right_options_d_left <- tribble(
  ~word,  ~left,  ~right,
  "dill", "dill", "till",
  "till", "dill", "till",
  "dip", "dip", "tip",
  "tip", "dip", "tip",
  "din", "din", "tin",
  "tin", "din", "tin",
)

unlabeled_left_right_options_d_right <- tribble(
  ~word,  ~left,  ~right,
  "dill", "till", "dill",
  "till", "till", "dill",
  "dip", "tip", "dip",
  "tip", "tip", "dip",
  "din", "tin", "din",
  "tin", "tin", "din",
)

labeled_left_right_options <- tribble(
  ~word,  ~left,  ~right,
  "dill", "dill", "din",
  "tin",  "till", "tin",
  "dip",  "din",  "dip",
  "tip",  "tip",  "tin",
  "din",  "din",  "dill",
  "till", "tin",  "till",
)

catch_left_right_options <- tribble(
  ~word,  ~left,  ~right,
  "flare", "flare", "share",
  "share", "rare", "share",
  "rare", "rare", "flare"
)

all_options_d_left <- bind_rows(
  catch_left_right_options |> mutate(category = "catch"),
  labeled_left_right_options |> mutate(category = "labeled"),
  unlabeled_left_right_options_d_left |> mutate(category = "unlabeled")
)

all_options_d_right <- bind_rows(
  catch_left_right_options |> mutate(category = "catch"),
  labeled_left_right_options |> mutate(category = "labeled"),
  unlabeled_left_right_options_d_right |> mutate(category = "unlabeled")
)

#for d-left lists
updated_stimlist_d_left <- stimlist_df |> 
  uncount(reps, .remove = FALSE) |> #expand repeated trials to separate rows
  mutate(VOT = str_extract(filename, "(?<=VOT)-?\\d+") %>% as.numeric()) |> #create "VOT" column
  separate(target_word, into = c("word", "label"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE) |> #create "word", "label" columns
  mutate(trial_type = if_else(word %in% c("flare", "rare", "share"), "catch", "exposure")) |> #create "trial_type" column
  mutate(
    filename_word_prefix = case_when(     #set up filename prefix based on the sound files    
      word == "till" ~ "dill",
      word == "tin"  ~ "din",
      word == "tip"  ~ "dip",
      TRUE           ~ word
    ),
    filename = if_else(
      trial_type == "catch",
      paste0(word, ".wav"),                          #rename catch trial
      paste0(filename_word_prefix, "_", VOT, ".wav") #rename exposure trial
    )
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    #rename "condition" column
    condition = case_when(   
      condition == "Shift0" ~ "expo-20ms",
      condition == "Shift10"  ~ "expo-10ms",
      condition == "Shift40"  ~ "expo+20ms"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(category = case_when(
    #map each type of trial with corresponding left and right options
    trial_type == "catch" ~ "catch",
    label == "labeled"   ~ "labeled",
    label == "unlabeled" ~ "unlabeled"
  )) |>
  left_join(all_options_d_left, by = c("word", "category")) |> 
  mutate(display = "exposure") |> 
  mutate(option_setup = "d-left") |> 
  # 移除暫時的輔助欄位
  select(-filename_word_prefix, -target_word, -image_selection, -feedback, -reps, -category) |> 
  select(display, trial_type, filename, word, VOT, label, condition, everything())

#save new csv files
condition_val <- unique(updated_stimlist_d_left$condition)
block_val <- unique(updated_stimlist_d_left$blockID)
option_setup_val <- unique(updated_stimlist_d_left$option_setup)

new_filename <- paste0(condition_val, "_", block_val, "_", option_setup_val, ".csv")
write.csv(updated_stimlist_d_left, 
          file = paste0("../exp1/new-gorilla-stimlists/", new_filename),
          row.names = FALSE)

print(paste("File saved:", new_filename))

```
